From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Jul 2027 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Scheduling: Cross-region morning demo block & timezone handoff

Hi Lina / Tomoko / Oliver,

Thanks again for the interest in Redwood Inference. A couple of customers in EMEA/APAC have requested morning-demo windows (their local mornings) and we thought it would be efficient to run a combined technical walkthrough that covers: 1) platform overview (15m), 2) latency/cost deep-dive and capacity conversation (20m), 3) security & compliance Q&A (15m), and 4) time for live Q&A (10m).

Proposed 2 blocks (all times shown in participants' local mornings — we'll send calendar invites in each area's local time):
- Option A: EMEA morning block — Wed 28 Jul 09:30 BST (45m)
- Option B: APAC morning block — Thu 29 Jul 10:00 JST (45m)

Please reply with your preferred block (A or B) and any specific items you want us to add to the agenda (e.g., SOC2 evidence, KV cache performance numbers, quantization profiles). I've attached a short agenda and a capacity checklist.

If you prefer a different day/time, tell us ranges and we'll attempt to stitch another block. We can run both if there is strong interest.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
[attachment: regional-demo-agenda.pdf (PDF)]

Hi Stephanie — thanks for organizing. AcmeCloud would like to attend the APAC block (Option B) if you run both; otherwise APAC preferred. Quick asks: 1) can we get a 15-minute slot at the end for security-specific questions with one of your security engineers? We have a narrow set of SOC2 audit questions. 2) Can you confirm whether the session will demo private (VPC) deployment options — that’s our primary gating factor.

If APAC is fixed on Thu 29 Jul 10:00 JST that works. Otherwise we can do Wed 28 Jul morning CEST with a note that our folks will be late afternoon local time.

Thanks,
